curatedMovie.curiosityHook: What sacrifices will Chun make to protect the boy's soul until it can return to the human world?
curatedMovie.description: Chun, a magical being who helps control nature's tides, visits the human world as a dolphin. When a mortal boy dies saving her, she risks everything to restore his soul at a devastating price.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Lush, sweeping fantasy adventure balanced by steady momentum and significant emotional stakes.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Directors Liang Xuan and Zhang Chun weave a rich, mythic fantasy where soaring animated wonder meets the sobering, deeply felt weight of magical consequences.
